stories.headline: South Korean AI Chip Startup Rebellions Raises $400M at $2.34B Valuation Ahead of IPO

key_facts.fact: Rebellions raised $400M in a pre-IPO round led by Mirae Asset Financial Group and the Korea National Growth Fund, bringing total funding to $850M.
key_facts.excerpt: Fresh off a successful Series C funding round in November, the South Korean fabless AI chip startup Rebellions has raised an additional $400 million... the company's total fundraising haul now stands at $850 million — $650 million of which was raised in the last six months.

key_facts.fact: The company's valuation sits at approximately $2.34 billion, and it plans an IPO later this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Meanwhile, the startup's valuation sits at approximately $2.34 billion, the company said Monday.

key_facts.fact: Rebellions also launched RebelRack and RebelPOD, AI infrastructure platforms for scalable inference compute.
key_facts.excerpt: Rebellions also announced the release of two new products: RebelRack and RebelPOD, which are described as AI infrastructure platforms.

key_facts.fact: The company has established entities in the US, Japan, Saudi Arabia, and Taiwan as part of its global expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: Rebellions' Chief Business Officer Marshall Choy — who is leading the company's global expansion efforts — said it had recently established entities in the U.S., Japan, Saudi Arabia, and Taiwan.

stories.headline: TSMC Fully Booked at 2nm Through 2028, Opening Door for Samsung Foundry

key_facts.fact: TSMC's 2nm process is fully booked through 2028 with orders from Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm, and Apple. Even its Arizona fab targeting 2030 production is reportedly largely reserved.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is effectively fully booked for the coming years, with orders for its cutting-edge 2-nanometer process flooding in from major customers including Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm and Apple. Even its planned Arizona fab, targeting mass production around 2030, is reportedly largely reserved before construction has begun.

key_facts.fact: Samsung, the only other company capable of 2nm production, has raised yields to around 60% and is securing orders from Tesla, Apple, and expanding engagement with Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung has raised yields on its 2nm process to around 60 percent and continues to improve performance. It is also gaining traction with key customers, securing orders from companies such as Tesla and Apple, expanding engagement with Nvidia.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang confirmed Samsung is producing the Grok 3 language processing unit using its 4nm process.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently said Samsung is producing the Grok 3 language processing unit using its 4nm process, highlighting its growing role in advanced chip manufacturing.

key_facts.fact: TSMC holds 72% of the global foundry market vs Samsung's 7%, but at sub-5nm nodes it is effectively a duopoly.
key_facts.excerpt: While TSMC accounted for about 72 percent of the global foundry market in the fourth quarter of last year, compared with Samsung's roughly 7 percent, the gap narrows significantly at the leading edge. Production below 5nm is effectively a duopoly between the two.

key_facts.fact: Samsung's Taylor, Texas fab is set to begin operations in the second half of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung is now moving to capitalize on the supply bottleneck, with its Taylor, Texas, fab set to begin operations in the second half of this year.

sources.title: AI demand chokes TSMC, gives Samsung opening
Samsung Foundry likely to pick up big orders as TSMC gets sold out until 2028

stories.headline: Nebius Announces $10B, 310MW AI Data Center in Finland, One of Europe's Largest

key_facts.fact: Amsterdam-based Nebius announced a 310-megawatt data center in Lappeenranta, Finland, with an estimated value exceeding $10 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: AI infrastructure firm Nebius Group on Tuesday said it was continuing its rapid European expansion with a 310-megawatt data centre in Finland, which would be one of the continent's largest with an estimated value of more than $10 billion.

key_facts.fact: The facility is being built by Finnish developer Polarnode and capacity is due to come online in phases from 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The Amsterdam-based company said capacity at its 10th site, which Finnish developer Polarnode is already building in Lappeenranta near Finland's eastern border with Russia, is due to come online in phases from 2027.

key_facts.fact: Nebius has recently won supply contracts worth more than $40 billion with Microsoft and Meta.
key_facts.excerpt: Nebius has recently won supply contracts worth more than $40 billion in total with U.S. software giants Microsoft and Meta.

key_facts.fact: The site will cover roughly 10% of Nebius' contracted capacity, which targets 3+ gigawatts by end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Lappeenranta will make a 'significant contribution' to achieving Nebius' capacity goals, which include securing more than 3 gigawatts of contracted capacity by the end of this year.

key_facts.fact: Finland was chosen for its low energy prices, renewable electricity supply, and cold climate that reduces cooling costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Finland is considered an attractive location for data centres because its low energy prices, renewable electricity supply and cold climate reduce cooling costs.

sources.title: Nebius furthers European expansion with $10 billion AI data centre in Finland

stories.headline: Airbus 'Bird of Prey' Counter-Drone Interceptor Completes First Demo Flight in Germany

key_facts.fact: The Airbus Bird of Prey interceptor drone completed its first demonstration flight at a military training area in northern Germany on March 30.
key_facts.excerpt: The Airbus 'Bird of Prey' interceptor drone successfully completed its first demonstration flight at a military training area in northern Germany.

key_facts.fact: The drone autonomously searched, detected, and classified a kamikaze drone, then engaged it with a Mark I air-to-air missile from startup Frankenburg Technologies.
key_facts.excerpt: In a realistic mission scenario, it autonomously searched, detected and classified a medium-sized one-way attack (kamikaze) drone. After successful identification, the Bird of Prey interceptor engaged the target with a Mark I air-to-air missile developed by defence tech start-up partner Frankenburg Technologies.

key_facts.fact: The prototype has a 2.5m wingspan, 160kg max takeoff weight, and can carry up to 8 missiles in the operational version. The Mark I missiles weigh under 2kg and are the lightest guided interceptors ever developed.
key_facts.excerpt: The Bird of Prey prototype used in the flight features a wingspan of 2.5 metres, a length of 3.1 metres, and a maximum take-off weight of 160 kg... The high-subsonic, fire-and-forget missiles have an engagement range of up to 1.5 kilometres, measure 65 centimetres in length and weigh less than 2 kg each, making them the lightest guided interceptors developed to date.

key_facts.fact: The demo took place just nine months after the project started. Airbus and Frankenburg plan live warhead tests throughout 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The demonstration flight took place just nine months after the project started... Airbus and Frankenburg plan to conduct additional flights with a live warhead throughout 2026.

sources.title: Successful first demo flight for Airbus uncrewed Bird of Prey interceptor

stories.headline: Varda Launches W-6 Mission to Advance Autonomous Hypersonic Reentry Capabilities

key_facts.fact: Varda Space Industries launched its W-6 vehicle on SpaceX's Transporter-16 on March 30, its sixth mission overall and first of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Varda Space Industries, the leader in orbital pharmaceutical processing and hypersonic reentry testbeds, announced the launch of its W-6 vehicle with SpaceX's Transporter-16 today, marking the company's sixth mission overall and its first launch of 2026.

key_facts.fact: W-6 carries an autonomous navigation system that uses onboard imagery to identify resident space objects for precise position determination during hypersonic flight.
key_facts.excerpt: The vehicle carries one interior payload, an autonomous navigation system that uses onboard imagery to identify resident space objects, including stars and low Earth orbit satellites, to determine precise vehicle position.

key_facts.fact: The mission carries a Sandia National Lab nose tile with advanced thermal protection materials and two instrumented shoulder tiles collecting data for NASA.
key_facts.excerpt: W-6 also carries a nose tile developed by Sandia National Laboratory that is embedded with small samples of advanced thermal protection materials... two instrumented shoulder tiles on the heatshield will collect in-flight thermal and performance data for NASA.

key_facts.fact: The mission is funded through a partnership between the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) and commercial space entities.
key_facts.excerpt: The mission is funded through a partnership between the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) and commercial space entities.

sources.title: Varda Launches W-6, Expanding Hypersonic Reentry and Autonomous Navigation Capabilities

stories.headline: Micron Shares Crash 30% Since Earnings as AI Memory Chip Shortage Deepens

key_facts.fact: Micron shares fell 10% on Monday March 30, bringing total decline to 30% since its earnings report on March 18.
key_facts.excerpt: Micron shares plummeted 10% on Monday, continuing the memory maker's significant post-earnings sell-off... the stock is down 30% since its blowout earnings report on March 18.

key_facts.fact: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said key customers only receive 'half to two-thirds of their requirements' due to the supply crunch driven by AI demand.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra told CNBC's 'Squawk on the Street' that key Micron customers only get 'half to two-thirds of their requirements' due to the supply crunch.

key_facts.fact: SanDisk fell 7% and Western Digital dropped 9% as the sell-off spread across memory makers.
key_facts.excerpt: memory makers SanDisk and Western Digital sank 7% and 9%, respectively.

key_facts.fact: Neocloud companies CoreWeave and Nebius were each down about 8% amid broader tech sell-off driven by rising oil prices from the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Other tech names also saw big losses Monday as oil climbed with the Iran war entering a fifth week... Neocloud companies CoreWeave and Nebius were each down about 8%.

sources.title: Micron stock sinks 10%, further cratering in post-earnings sell-off

stories.headline: SpaceX Starlink Satellite Explodes in Orbit, Second Such Incident Since December

key_facts.fact: SpaceX lost contact with Starlink satellite 34343 after an 'anomaly' on Sunday March 29 at approximately 560km altitude.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX says it lost contact with a Starlink satellite after suffering an 'anomaly.'... The latest mishap occurred at about 560km above the Earth.

key_facts.fact: Space-tracking company Leo Labs detected 'tens of objects' near the satellite, suggesting it broke apart or exploded.
key_facts.excerpt: space-tracking company Leo Labs says it 'immediately detected tens of objects in the vicinity' of Starlink 34343 after the event.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX says the event poses no risk to the ISS, its crew, or the upcoming Artemis II mission. Debris expected to burn up within weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Latest analysis shows the event poses no new risk to the @Space_Station, its crew, or to the upcoming launch of NASA's Artemis II mission,' says SpaceX.

key_facts.fact: This is the second similar incident since December, when SpaceX also suddenly lost a satellite that seemingly exploded.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX suffered a similar episode in December when it suddenly lost communications with a satellite that also seemingly exploded.

key_facts.fact: Over 24,000 objects are tracked in low Earth orbit, including about 10,000 Starlink satellites. SpaceX recently requested FCC approval for up to one million AI satellites.
key_facts.excerpt: over 24,000 objects, including debris and about 10,000 Starlink satellites, are currently being tracked... In January, SpaceX requested approval from the FCC for 'up to one million satellites' to create orbital data centers.

sources.title: Another Starlink satellite has inexplicably exploded

stories.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Robot Returns to Hollywood Diner With Food Runner Ambitions

key_facts.fact: Tesla's Optimus Gen 3 robot is returning to the Tesla Diner on Santa Monica Boulevard in Hollywood, as announced via @Tesla_Optimus on March 30.
key_facts.excerpt: Now, the robot is set to return with a more demanding job... 'Back to work / See you at Tesla Diner tomorrow' — @Tesla_Optimus, March 30, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Gen 3 Optimus features 50 total actuators and 22 degrees of freedom per hand, with Tesla's AI5 chip and Grok-powered voice interaction.
key_facts.excerpt: With improved hand dexterity that features 50 total actuators and 22 degrees of freedom per hand, and significantly more powerful processing through Tesla's latest AI5 chip that includes Grok-powered voice interaction.

key_facts.fact: Musk has ambitions for Optimus to serve as a food runner in 2026, delivering meals to cars at Supercharger stalls.
key_facts.excerpt: Musk has ambitions for Optimus to take on a food runner role in 2026, delivering meals directly to cars at the Supercharger stalls.

key_facts.fact: Tesla is converting its Fremont Model S and Model X production lines to build Optimus robots, after discontinuing those vehicle models.
key_facts.excerpt: At the Q4 2025 earnings call in January, Musk announced Tesla would discontinue the Model S and Model X and convert those Fremont production lines to build Optimus.

stories.headline: London AI Chip Startup Fractile in Talks to Raise $200M at $1B Unicorn Valuation

key_facts.fact: Fractile is in discussions with Accel and early backer Oxford Science Enterprises to raise over $200M at a $1B valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: London-based AI chip maker Fractile is seeking to raise $200m in funding at a $1bn valuation. The startup is in discussions with Accel and early backer Oxford Science Enterprises (OSE).

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2022, Fractile builds chips for AI inference that it says work faster and cheaper than Nvidia's GPUs. Backers include NATO Innovation Fund and Arm cofounder Hermann Hauser.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2022, Fractile builds hardware and software solutions for AI inference, including chips which it says work more efficiently, quickly and cheaply than US giant Nvidia's GPUs... Backers include the Nato Innovation Fund (NIF), Cocoa VC, Kindred Capital and Arm cofounder Hermann Hauser.

key_facts.fact: The UK AI minister recently announced Fractile would invest £100M building operations in London and Bristol, including a new engineering facility.
key_facts.excerpt: Last month, the UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan announced the company would invest £100m building up operations in London and Bristol, including a new engineering facility.

key_facts.fact: The company raised $15M in a 2024 seed round and a further $22.5M from NIF, Kindred, and OSE.
key_facts.excerpt: The company raised $15m in 2024 and Sifted reported in February that it had secured a further $22.5m from NIF, Kindred and OSE.

stories.headline: Fermi Shares Plunge 25% on $486M Loss, No Tenant for Nuclear AI Data Center Project

key_facts.fact: Fermi shares fell about 25% on Monday after reporting a GAAP net loss of $486.4M ($1.13/share), exceeding analyst expectations of $366.5M.
key_facts.excerpt: Fermi Inc's shares fell about 25% on Monday morning after the company reported a steep first-year loss... posted a GAAP net loss of $486.4 million, or $1.13 per share... exceeding analyst expectations for a $366.5 million loss.

key_facts.fact: The company, which went public in October, is now down roughly 80% from its IPO level and has yet to generate revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: The company, which went public in October and is now down roughly 80% from its IPO level, has yet to generate revenue.

key_facts.fact: A key nonbinding letter of intent to lease part of its Project Matador nuclear-powered data center site was terminated in December without a replacement.
key_facts.excerpt: Fermi had announced a nonbinding letter of intent in September to lease part of the site, but the agreement was terminated in December without a replacement.

key_facts.fact: Fermi, co-founded by former US Energy Secretary Rick Perry, is building Project Matador to supply nuclear energy to AI data centers. Cash stood at $408.5M at end of Q4.
key_facts.excerpt: Fermi, co-founded by former US Energy Secretary Rick Perry, is seeking to position itself at the intersection of nuclear energy and the fast-growing demand for power from AI-driven data centers... At the end of the fourth quarter, Fermi reported cash and cash equivalents of $408.5 million.
